list.name: role
list.label: Node Role
list.description: Filter test cluster pod metrics by node role (master/worker). Only affects Test Cluster Utilization panels.

options.content:
### Reading this dashboard

Start with all filters set to "All" to see the big picture, then select a **PR** to drill into a specific pull request. When a PR is selected, all panels scope to that PR -- compare its success rate against the global baseline to tell if failures are isolated or systemic.

PR numbers, commit SHAs, and Build IDs in tables are clickable links to GitHub and Prow.

panels.title: Avg Retests / Commit
panels.description: Average pipeline runs per commit. Values above 1 mean commits are being retested.

panels.title: Top Failing PRs
panels.description: PRs with the most failed builds in the selected time range.

targets.expr: topk(20, count by (pr_number) (last_over_time(ci_test_platform_insights_additional_context_duration_seconds{name="execution_completed",success="false",pr_number=~"$pr_number",job_name=~"$job_type",repo=~"$repo"}[$__range])) and on() (count(count by (pr_number) (last_over_time(ci_test_platform_insights_additional_context_duration_seconds{name="execution_completed",success="false",pr_number=~"$pr_number",job_name=~"$job_type",repo=~"$repo"}[$__range]))) > 1))

panels.title: PR Success Rate vs Global
panels.description: Compare a specific PR's success rate to the overall system. If both are low, it's systemic. If only yours is low, investigate your code.

panels.title: Top Failing Steps
panels.description: Steps with the most failures within the selected scope.

panels.title: Longest Runs
panels.description: Individual pipeline runs sorted by duration. Long runs may indicate stuck tests or infrastructure issues.

panels.title: Shortest Runs
panels.description: Runs that completed unusually fast. Short failed runs often indicate infrastructure failures rather than test failures.

panels.title: Build History
panels.description: All builds matching the current filters. Shows pass/fail pattern across commits.

panels.title: Errors & Warnings
panels.description: Pipeline-level errors and warnings from ci-operator logs for the selected scope.

targets.expr: repo:~"${repo:pipe}" AND pr_number:~"$pr_number" AND build_id:~"$build_id" AND (level:error OR level:warning)

panels.title: Step Failures
panels.description: Step-level failures from ci-operator logs for the selected scope.

targets.expr: repo:~"${repo:pipe}" AND pr_number:~"$pr_number" AND build_id:~"$build_id" AND level:error AND _msg:~"failed|Failed"

panels.title: Avg CPU Utilization
panels.description: Average worker node CPU utilization across test clusters for the selected scope. Low values indicate workers are over-provisioned.

panels.title: Avg Memory Utilization
panels.description: Average worker node memory utilization across test clusters for the selected scope. Includes cache/buffers (reclaimable under pressure).

panels.title: Builds with Data
panels.description: Number of builds in scope that have test cluster Prometheus data. Builds that fail before the gather-extra step won't have data.

panels.title: CPU Usage vs Capacity
panels.description: CPU usage vs total cluster capacity (master + worker nodes). Min/avg/max across matching builds.

panels.title: Memory Usage vs Capacity
panels.description: Memory usage vs total cluster capacity (master + worker nodes). Min/avg/max across matching builds.

panels.title: Pod CPU Requests vs Capacity
panels.description: Total concurrent pod CPU requests across all nodes (master + worker) vs total cluster capacity. Uses a 5m lookback so only running pods are counted.

panels.title: Pod Memory Requests vs Capacity
panels.description: Total concurrent pod memory requests across all nodes (master + worker) vs total cluster capacity. Uses a 5m lookback so only running pods are counted.

panels.title: Per-Build Utilization
panels.description: CPU and memory utilization per build. Helps identify builds with unusual resource consumption.
